description: This PHP class defines validation rules for inaccessible entity IDs within the OrangeHRM system. It manages configuration options such as exception handling, permissions, and roles for access validation purposes.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityIdOption
classes.description: A class that encapsulates validation options and behaviors for inaccessible entity IDs in the system.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception object used for validation failure, lazily instantiating a ForbiddenException if null.

methods.name: setThrowable
methods.description: Sets the exception object to be used for validation failures.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current exception message string.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets the exception message string used by the exception.

methods.name: isThrow
methods.description: Indicates whether the validation should throw an exception upon failure.

methods.name: setThrow
methods.description: Configures whether to throw an exception on validation failure.

methods.name: isThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Indicates whether to throw an exception if only the entity exists.

methods.name: setThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Sets the behavior of throwing an exception if only the entity exists.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions required to access the entity.

methods.name: setRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Sets the required permissions for entity access validation.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Retrieves roles that should be excluded from access.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to be excluded from access considerations.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Retrieves roles that are explicitly included for access.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to be included for access considerations.
